newsitem.title: JAPAN: NYMEX crude cools down in ACCESS trade.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX crude cools down in ACCESS trade.

text.p: NYMEX crude prices cooled markedly in out-of-hours Access trade on Monday after Friday's searing gains.
June WTI traded at $21.92 early on Monday, down from Friday's New York close of $22.12.
Friday's NYMEX gains came on the back of technical buying, as June contracts broke through key price levels, signalling a stronger market for analysts charting crude values.
Bulls took heart from news on Friday that North Sea loadings were expected to fall by about 12.50 million barrels in the shorter month of June due to maintenance programmes.
